newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.002pts to 101.159.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.002pts to 101.159.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds rose 0.002 points in Friday's trading to 101.159, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.002 points to 2.492 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, rose 0.007 points to 97.409, the bank said, while the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.266 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 rose 0.028 points to 1,128.602.
